NEXT_ONE_experiment.name: SGD1_all-schema_partial-belief_CPU_rollout
NEXT_ONE_experiment.purpose: Train real publisher intent/requested-slot/state-map-presence/USER-act and supported KEEP/SET hypotheses from complex context. This is partial semantic belief prediction, not complete value-valued DST or policy imitation.
fixed_auxiliary_comparisons: latest-utterance-only evaluation sensitivity, explicitly reduced information
oracle previous-state inference diagnostic on same frozen weights, explicitly oracle and distribution-shifted
controlled-history comparison using one common causal reference model's predictions for both arms
NEXT_ONE_experiment.no_arbitrary_auxiliary_floor: Train observed supported labels after actual corpus/plan freeze. No20-per-class/fold deployment floor blocks auxiliary fitting. Report rare/absent class support; never impute missing targets.
NEXT_ONE_experiment.initialization: Fresh deterministic SGD-head/encoder initialization; do not transplant77-way teacher labels into SGD schema labels. Preserve all already trained weights and ongoing three-source code.

field_adapter.group: ancestry.group_id; ancestry.dialogue_id,source_turn_index for whole-dialogue ordering/bookkeeping only
field_adapter.current_source: USER current input plus up-to8 previous observed USER/SYSTEM turns; actual current gold frames never input
field_adapter.schema_inputs: All26 frozen official TRAIN service schemas for EVERY event. Schema descriptions, slot/intent descriptors and declared schema edges are public task specification; never select/filter them from current targets.frames or dialogue services metadata.
field_adapter.service_mask: service_supervision_masks[s] AND frame.head_masks[h] affects loss only. False service supervision means unknown, not service-negative. No oracle service routing at prediction.
field_adapter.act_targets: Multi-hot actual frame.actions[].act, using TRAIN-discovered publisher action vocabulary; mask frame.head_masks.publisher_actions. Unsupported new act remains unknown. AFFIRM/NEGATE are publisher semantic acts, not financial consent or bank refusal.
field_adapter.update_target: belief_updates[j].publisher_map_update in KEEP/SET only when update_mask=true. Current collector DELETE_mask=false always; no DELETE class or inferred deletion. Hashes/values used to establish targets are excluded from feature encoder.
field_adapter.value_mask: No slot value prediction in this fast pilot. Even recoverable target values never become current input features. Privacy-sensitive or unrecoverable identity targets remain masked. Values in predicted belief remain UNKNOWN.
field_adapter.required_invariant: Replacing or permuting targets,service_supervision_masks,record_id,source indices or slot-value hashes must leave emitted input feature tensors byte-identical. Only loss-target tensors change.

tensors.batch: 32 distinct TRAIN dialogues at a time; unroll up-to4 chronological USER events per dialogue; pad and mask ended dialogues, no turn shuffle. B<=128events, N<=9observed turn nodes,D512,H32.
tensors.X: float32[B,N,512] normalized signed hash of sanitized lexical features plus USER/SYSTEM/local-age node types; whole current utterance and every earlier context text available in both arms
tensors.node_mask: bool[B,N]; empty observed text represented by explicit empty node, not silently dropped
tensors.adjacency: directed observed-order edges only; optional static schema intent-slot required/optional links identically visible to both arms; never target-frame edges
tensors.schema_queries: Fixed hashed descriptions projected to32d:26services,79service-local intent queries including26NONE,215slot queries. Local schema IDs identify output coordinates, not hidden service routing.
tensors.previous_belief: Detached predicted per-service intent distributions, requested-slot and presence probabilities and uncertainty flags; initialized unknown for every dialogue. No current/previous gold state in mandatory arms.
tensors.target_intent: int64[B,26] plus bool[B,26] known mask; each service has its own schema-local softmax
tensors.target_slots: float32[B,215] requested/presence with separate bool masks; nonexistent/unobserved service labels UNKNOWN
tensors.target_acts: float32[B,26,A] plus per-frame masks, A derived from actually observed TRAIN published actions
tensors.target_updates: int64[B,215] binary KEEP/SET plus bool recoverability/consecutive-state mask; no imputed DELETE
tensors.mask_note: Head and element masks derive from actual annotations for supervision only; they are not input features or inference-time pruning.

model_math.encoder: h_i=tanh(x_i E+b),E512x32. Base readout c=concat_or_fixed_sum(h_current,mean(h_all_observed),project(predicted_prior)). Base whole-current/whole-context path is present in BOTH arms.
model_math.relations: m_i=sum_r mean_neighbors(h_j W_r). G adds learned projected relation summary to c; equal-information arm sets only m to0. All lexical nodes, current whole-turn base, schema queries, prior-belief projection, pooling and train schedule remain available. Shape-identical zero-effect matrices retained.
model_math.schema_scoring: z_h(s,j)=p^T W_h q_(s,j)+b_h+v_h^T features_of_predicted_prior(s,j). Score EVERY service/slot. Intent CE normalizes within each service; requested/presence sigmoid and KEEP/SET binary score are shared query heads. No gold service-gated feature branch.
model_math.routing_limit: Output all service-conditioned hypotheses with relevance UNKNOWN. Current masks do not provide supervised negative service routing. Do not label conditional intent accuracy as end-to-end service selection or full DST. A future relevance head needs independently justified complete service-set labels; no positive-unlabeled prior guessed here.
model_math.loss: L=mean_known_service_CE/log(max(2,C_s)) +maskedBCE(requested)/log2 +maskedBCE(presence)/log2 +0.5maskedBCE(actualacts)/log2 +0.25maskedCE(KEEP,SET)/log2 +0.0005||theta||^2. Normalize each head over its own known targets, then equal closure-group mass; report raw components and supports.
model_math.group_weight: Sample closure groups uniformly, dialogue uniformly within group, chronological USER events as a sequence; exact per-event weights1/(number_groups*dialogues_in_group*USER_events_in_dialogue). Group/dialogue size metadata frozen before training. Avoid long-dialogue dominance.
model_math.rollout: For each event, predict all schema-local distributions from earlier text and own predicted prior, compute masked loss, then detach and store predicted distributions for next event. Never insert current gold even for an untrained/unobserved service. SYSTEM turns enter observed text history only.
model_math.state_semantics: Probabilistic publisher-map presence can change as a semantic hypothesis; it cannot delete a bank fact. KEEP/SET predicts an observed map-update label but values stayUNKNOWN. Exact joint slot-value accuracy is inapplicable; do not fabricate it.
model_math.oracle_comparison: Separate named diagnostic replacing predicted prior with previous known published frame state, never current frame. On absent prior state keepUNKNOWN. Same frozen weights gives sensitivity, not a separately trained oracle upper bound; report distribution-shift caveat.

streaming_algorithm: Require final collector status/frozenmanifest/global closure and exact plan source hashes; no preview promotion.
TRAIN-only index provides shard/dialogue offsets, group IDs, lengths and ordering. Load at most one<=20MBshard plus batch; no dense all-corpus feature matrix.
Fixed seed permutes whole closure groups; sequence loader carries own predicted belief per dialogue across minibatches and resets at dialogue/split end.
Build input tensors from allowlisted observed fields and all frozen schema queries, targets independently; compare annotation-mutation feature invariance before fitting.
Run two arms with identical minibatch order, initial parameters, epochs and optimizer. Each maintains its own detached predicted prior for main closed-loop metrics.
Freeze weights/export hashes before CAL. Partition CAL whole closure groups into disjoint temperature-fit and threshold-select; no EVAL-based tuning.
Score internal EVAL sequentially only after freeze. Report own-history rollout and common causal reference-history ablation separately; oracle prior is separately marked.

equal_information_ablation.feature_equality: Both arms receive identical observed texts, roles, local positions, all schema descriptors and base prior-state representation; retain whole-turn direct path so no-edge does not discard source information.
equal_information_ablation.history_control: For relation-only conditional comparison, use frozen zero-relations model's causal prior predictions as the common history for both; no gold. Main closed-loop arm scores use own histories and measure combined dynamics, not pure edge effect.
equal_information_ablation.paired_metrics: Store per-event/frame prediction error pairs and aggregate disagreements by closure group. Report per-head loss/F1 differences, bootstrap/group sensitivity with dependence limits, no automatic significant-graph claim.
equal_information_ablation.latest_only: Remove earlier context and prior in a declared evaluation sensitivity only; this is deliberately lower-information, not the clean relation ablation.

CPU_one_experiment_limits.full_TRAIN_pass: Use every admitted full-packet TRAIN sequence once if budget permits. One epoch is a bounded learning pilot, not convergence. Report exact groups/rows/steps consumed; if timeout before fixed endpoint mark partial/unscored rather than claiming full-corpus results.
CPU_one_experiment_limits.profiling: First5TRAINbatches are part of actual fit, not hidden extra fits; record step time/RSS and project full pass walltime. If projected deadline fails, stop at cap and report bottleneck, without adaptive data or EVAL changes.

minimum_teacher_to_portable.separate_trial: Small subsequent B77 distillation trial; do not inject into ongoing three-source/SGD code or claim it executed. Actual89.83vs78.45 motivates lexical compression, not synthetic policy relabeling.
minimum_teacher_to_portable.TRAIN_only: Cache raw uncalibrated77logits for exactly7943 frozen B77 TRAIN source texts/IDs. Targets hash commits encoder/head/tokenizer/preprocessing/TRAIN hash. Do not use CAL-fitted teacher temperature, threshold0.64, CAL/EVAL/OOD logits or acceptance decisions as training supervision. TRAIN raw teacher logits are soft targets only. Threshold0.64 is a decision cutoff, never a logit temperature.
minimum_teacher_to_portable.student: Portable signed word/bigram/characterhash1024 ->32tanh ->77softmax, separate from SGD heads. Compare same fresh architecture hard-only versus hard+KD; no old-model weight reuse.
minimum_teacher_to_portable.loss: 0.5CE(p_student,y_publisher)+0.5*tau^2 KL(softmax(z_teacher/tau)||softmax(z_student/tau)),tau2; hard-only control has identical schedule and input dimensions. Teacher errors remain soft supervision, not gold.
minimum_teacher_to_portable.schedule: Fixedseed,90epochs,Adam0.01,batch128,twoCPUthreads; cache<=120s/twofits<=240s/total<=420s in a separate bound plan. Timeout partial, not invented loss.
minimum_teacher_to_portable.measurement: Freeze both arms before disjoint CAL-fit/CAL-select then reused internal EVAL; report CE,F1,classsupport,teacher agreement,hard errors,latency/package size and teacher-student gap. Current EVAL already exposed, so improvement is diagnostic rather than blind qualification.
minimum_teacher_to_portable.ontology: B77 teacher supplies only its77source topics. No mapping to SGD intents, slot updates, completed payment, consent or bank outcomes without new reviewed target contract.

portable_export.format: Finite JSON+base64little-endianfloat32 or verified per-columnint8; stdlib math/hashlib/re/struct/base64, no external inference
portable_export.architecture_budget: SGD query-shared512x32encoder plus bounded32x32relation/readout/prior matrices. Keep total trainable runtime coefficients<=60000 (float32base64<=320000bytes); use remaining180000 for actual schema descriptors, taxonomies and inference. Verify actual totalbytes; don't hide schema or tokenizer outside count.
portable_export.loading: Verify exact artifact hash/taxonomy/shapes and finite coefficients, positive finite temperature/valid thresholds; invalid artifact returns explicit unavailable/abstain, not exception-driven permission.
portable_export.parity: Cover every trained service/head/act class, source-valid empty context, padded turns, rare classes, near ties and source threshold flips. Exact labels alone are insufficient: report max logit/probability deviations and changed decisions. Preserve full-precision arrays in freeze for reconstructible future parity.
portable_export.live_boundary: Offline/shadow proposals only. FixedAGENT_LLM+banktools remain live platform authority; no authenticated current ingress proof was invented. Learned beliefs do not mutate policy facts, receipts, component revisions, refusal or consent.

evaluation_requirements.data_splits: Final global closure-group split plan from officialTRAIN only; preserve all shards/descendants. Do not fit partial preview and call full descendants independent. Officialdev/test remain unopened in this iteration.
evaluation_requirements.conditional_heads: Service-local CE/F1 only on actual known supervision; acts/requested/presence each has own mask denominator. Missing frame,state,act field isunknown, not negative. Report service coverage separately; no oracle routed main metric.
evaluation_requirements.rollout: Plot/report loss/error by USERturn index and previous-belief error; exact source-map membership metrics only. No full joint goal accuracy without predicted slot values.
evaluation_requirements.calibration: Per-head shared temperature on CAL-fit; thresholds on separate CAL-select groups. Calibration and auxiliary empirical precision do not authorize financial acts. Zero support means unavailable, not safe negative.
